title: Lazar's account deserves some probability if reverse-engineering programs exist

tellings.quote: Well, it's kind of intellectually disingenuous to say simultaneously I believe they're see covert reverse engineering programs and then also say the one guy with probably the most coherent story around having worked on a craft is 100% wrong.

plain: Michels argues that if you believe the government has secret reverse-engineering programs, meaning efforts to take apart recovered craft and learn how they work, you cannot also call Bob Lazar 100% wrong. Lazar is a man who says he worked on such a craft in Nevada in 1989. Michels makes the case himself and calls Lazar's story probably the most coherent one around, so it deserves at least some chance of being true.
